niche: a catchment management agency's dry-season sulfate load allocations for coal-mine drainage, read at boundary monitors set at gauging weirs a few kilometres below mine-stream confluences
analyst_test: A strong analyst conforms the laboratory results, units and gauged flows, multiplies each resource unit's boundary-monitor concentration on every routine run by the boundary gauge's flow that day, averages May to September and flags the units whose mean run load tops their allocation, a set that is wrong because the boundary monitors below the mine-stream confluences sample one inflow's unmixed plume.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each resource unit's sulfate flux past its boundary, which river water-quality practice reads as a representative, fully mixed concentration times flow, and the lateral mixing of a tributary into a river over kilometres below a confluence is river hydraulics that has no meaning once the nouns are a hospital's or a school's.

spine.entity: one laboratory result for one analyte on one routine sample at one monitoring site

world.geography: South Africa, KwaZulu-Natal (a fictional catchment management agency, its rivers, mines and people)

driver: The quantity a unit carries out is read at a single point its inflows reach before they have mixed, so the point reports whichever inflow runs along its side rather than the blend of the unit's whole flow, and only the sum of what each inflow carries in, measured where that inflow is already mixed, gives what the unit carries out.
driver_concrete: Each resource unit's dry-season sulfate load is read at its boundary monitor, set at a gauging weir within the lateral mixing zone a few kilometres below a mine stream's confluence, so its samples carry the mine stream's concentration or the main river's depending on the bank it stands on; the unit's load is what its two inflows carry in, each from its own well-mixed monitor and gauge, which the river conserves to the boundary.
stump: A competent analyst multiplies each boundary monitor's run concentrations by the boundary gauge's flow, averages the dry season's run loads and flags the units whose mean tops the allocation; the step that lands it there is taking the boundary sample as the unit's water, when a monitor within a few kilometres of a confluence samples one inflow's unmixed plume and the unit's load is what its inflows carry in.

differentiation.task84: task84 groups a unit's concurrently live copies on a composite key and prices their competition premium from removal episodes; here one unit's outgoing quantity is rebuilt from its inflows because its only reading point is unmixed, and nothing is grouped or priced.
differentiation.task257: task257 counts the latent dimensions of categorical items whose correlations skewed codes cap; here a flux past a boundary is rebuilt by conservation from inflows measured where each is mixed, with no latent structure estimated.
differentiation.task269: task269 and its Callowfield lineage estimate a rate or a reliability from occasions or scorers sampled unrepresentatively in time or by rota; here the reading is unrepresentative in space, across a river's width, and the golden is a conservation sum rather than a resampling, variance or reliability model.

lineage.architecture: v1 (Wealdmoor County Council digit filter: the 2027/28 call-off of routed payments for post-payment examination)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-10: in-house solver rounds 1 and 2 landed (80.2, 85.1), judge SEND_BACK on hygiene (the payments ledger read as generated); FAILED_TO_STUMP, re-rooted 2026-10-12 under the no-retirement rule
lineage.driver: The forward count of items a fixed band rule selects includes units outside the band today: each unit's periodic amount is one sum over every component it holds, a filed date in the forward window ends one class of component, and re-summing what survives moves the unit's amount into the selected band; some units are paid in two equal parts to two linked payees, and how a unit is paid depends on how many components it keeps, because the record's own changed units show that a unit left with one component is paid its whole amount by the first payee and nothing by the second; a forecast that treats every linked unit as always paid in halves carries the one-component units' halves below the band's lower floor and out of the count, and only applying the payment rule recovered from the changed units puts each such unit's whole amount into the band once a period, after a fixed-term cohort run-off on a term recovered from an earlier completed cohort, the whole-amount decomposition and the linked-pair re-sum have all been made and read as final.

lineage.architecture: v2 (Merrowland Statistics' Household Labour Survey: the three-visit cap on first interviews read intake by intake)
lineage.fate: retired 2026-10-31 at the batch audit: shipped before the survivor-anatomy gates and short of all three (the intake and visit number schema-visible through the serial, the field's estimator re-run as the golden, the decisive step exact arithmetic); re-rooted rather than repaired
lineage.driver: A change at the point units are recruited filters out a hard-to-reach share whose outcomes differ from the rest, and because every recruited unit stays for a fixed run of later periods carrying part of that difference, the distortion in the aggregate compounds while filtered intakes are still being issued and decays for a full run after the change is reversed; the unit the change acts on is the intake and not the period, so each period's distortion is a re-estimate on that period's own mix of filtered and unfiltered intakes and the change between two filtered periods is the change in that mix, while the first-period gap repeated while the change lasts files no change at all and the same gap applied at every position overstates every period.
lineage.stump: A competent solver finds the cap in the field instruction, measures how much dropping the households first interviewed at a fourth to sixth visit moves a wave-1 intake (0.21 point on the unemployment rate) and files that one gap for every quarter the cap is issued and 0.00 from April to June 2027, with none of the 0.27-point July to September rise the cap, so the rise is real; the step that lands it there is taking the unit the change acts on to be the quarter's fieldwork, when it is the intake, which the panel keeps for five quarters, so each published quarter is a mix of capped and uncapped intakes, the gap compounds to 0.62 point by January to March 2027 and the change between two capped quarters is the change in the mix, not zero.
